thread:
alex: Pushed a quick repro for the new orion-adapt model. Getting repeatable perplexity spike after int8 quant. Suspect rotary frame mismatch between Gemma head layout and the LLaMA-style rotary implementation.

maria: Can you paste the minimal repro? :thinking:

alex: Sure — run:

```
python tools/onboard_check.py --model orion-adapt --batch 4 --seq 1024 --quant int8
```

logs show a sharp divergence at token 23 across seeds.

ken: Is this the headwise vs interleaved head layout we've seen before or something orthogonal in the rotation basis?

alex: Looks orthogonal. When I dumped the per-head rotary basis (float32) the even heads have a ~90deg phase offset vs odd heads. Example slice:

```
head 0 matrix orthonormity: 0.9987
head 1 matrix orthonormity: 0.9985 (rotated ~1.5708 rad)
```

sophie: That smells like a different default convention: Gemma uses frame order [cos,sin] while our LLaMA import assumes [sin,-cos] for some legacy codepath.

maria: If it's a basis sign or permutation, quant will amplify it. Do you see differences in the packed qkv ordering too?

alex: qkv ordering matches, it's only the rotary application. Quick patch I tried: flip per-head phase for even heads with `phase -= pi/2` before applying rotary. It brings perplexity down to baseline in the smoke run.

ken: Oof. So a headwise phase offset. Might be introduced during convert script when reshaping head dims. Can you point to the convert step?

alex: converter log snippet:

```
# converter.py
w = np.reshape(flat, (n_heads, head_dim, 2))  # suspicious reshape
```

maria: That reshape losing contiguous layout could permute the implicit sin/cos pairs. We should update converter to explicitly parse sin/cos channels by name, not rely on a magic reshape.

alex: Agreed. Opening a PR with two things: 1) explicit sin/cos mapping in converter, 2) unit test that dumps per-head phase differences and asserts mean abs(angle) < 0.01.

dev-bot: CI started for PR #2145

ken: Also add a backcompat flag: `--legacy-rotary-frame` so models converted before this change still load predictably.

sophie: Add an eval check in the onboarding pipeline: run small int8 smoke and compare to fp16 baseline logprobs with tolerance.

alex: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/orchestration/pull/2145

maria: Ran the CI patch locally, tests pass. Also added a small quant noise check; int8 now within 0.5% logprob delta for our small prompt suite.

ci-bot: CI passed: all checks green

ken: Nice. Can you add a short note in onboarding checklist? "Check rotary frame parity across heads; run phase-dump test".

alex: Done — added to docs and the onboarding script now emits a readable CSV `rotary_phase_angles.csv`.

sophie: Recording this in model-handoff: orion-adapt conversion had orthogonal-frame mismatch; resolved by explicit sin/cos mapping + backcompat flag.

maria: Great work. Moving to close once we've verified on dedicated infra.

alex: Verified on dedicated with 8-GPU int8 runs — stable. Marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
